description: This file implements the DRX resource management for a 5G NR protocol stack, including classes and methods for managing DRX offsets, handling UE creation, updates, and removal, specifically for managing DRX configurations in a cellular network.

classes.name: ocudu::odu::drx_offset_pool
classes.description: Manages a pool of DRX start offsets for UEs, distributing offsets evenly across the cycle.

methods.name: du_drx_resource_manager::handle_ue_creation
methods.description: Handles the creation of a UE, initializing DRX configuration as disabled.

methods.name: du_drx_resource_manager::handle_ue_cap_update
methods.description: Updates the DRX configuration for a UE based on network support and previous state.

methods.name: du_drx_resource_manager::handle_ue_removal
methods.description: Removes DRX configuration for a UE and deallocates associated resources.
